text.7:195: Have they feet wherewith they walk, or have they hands wherewith they hold, or have they eyes wherewith they see, or have they ears wherewith they hear? Say: Call upon your (so-called) partners (of Allah), and then contrive against me, spare me not!
text.11:55: Beside Him. So (try to) circumvent me, all of you, give me no respite.
text.12:5: He said: O my dear son! Tell not thy brethren of thy vision, lest they plot a plot against thee. Lo! Satan is for man an open foe.
text.12:76: Then he (Joseph) began the search with their bags before his brother's bag, then he produced it from his brother's bag. Thus did We contrive for Joseph. He could not have taken his brother according to the king's law unless Allah willed. We raise by grades (of mercy) whom We will, and over every lord of knowledge there is one more knowing.
text.21:57: And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs.
text.77:39: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me.
text.86:15: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)
text.86:16: And I plot a plot (against them).
